title: Tried and True!
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 28, 2026
review: This is the only thing that has worked for us.  I have the little traps and the top that looks like a leaf and I catch a dozen  a week, easy!  Highly recommend!!! I even tried the electronic one and this works better in my opinion!

title: Does the job
date: Reviewed in the United States on June 22, 2025
review: I bought this by mistake thinking that it was the one for the gnats. It is supposed to be catching flies and it caught one fly. It says that it is not intended to catch gnats, but hey it caught quite a bit. The size may be small but it does what it was intended to do. I know it says to put a few drops but I placed the one whole container into the cup with a little water. The smell is not to loud but will catch you off guard.

title: Good
date: Reviewed in the United States on August 4, 2025
review: These are not bad but i do notice less flys in my trap. Im not sure if this is because i got them all with the bottle that came in my fly trap of if this is just attracting less. Either way i still am finding fruit flies in my trap

title: Effective & not smelly
date: Reviewed in the United States on March 30, 2026
review: This stuff is super effective. Fruit flies love it. We have little apple-shaped traps and when I fill them with this stuff, they’re full of dead fruit flies within hours. The bottles are easy to squeeze with a good control top, so the liquid doesn’t spill. And the liquid itself has a slight odor but isn’t strong at all. You probably won’t notice it once you’ve filled your trap and set it out to do its job. We’ve had fruit flies a few times and I’ve used this each time, and it definitely works. Took care of the pests within a few days.

title: Works well.
date: Reviewed in the United States on February 14, 2026
review: These are great refills. My son is careless with fruits. And, fruit flies multiply quickly. I have those plastic fruit like containers in the kitchen and bathroom. It takes a few days but this stuff draws the fruit flies and the traps keep them from getting out. And, my cats don't get poised from them.

title: It really works.
date: Reviewed in the United States on April 21, 2026
review: Had an invasion of fruit flies in kitchen and bathroom.  I was amazed to see how many of the little insects were floating dead after the first day.  Each day there were more and now I hardly have any.  It is very easy to use.

title: Waste of money
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 29, 2026
review: I had this in half the traps and Terro brand in the other half. These evaporated in days and killed a few flies. The Terro brand is still going and killed a bunch of flies. It’s worth getting the name brand.

title: It's O.K.
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 2, 2026
review: It's just O.K.  Not as good as previous brand.
